note: The fighting clips (C1, approved October 27, 2026; docs/future/16-the-sea-cave.md, the five shared poses): Matt's Meshy clips retargeted onto the walker's rig by tools/figure-prep/clips.py --set fight into file, a set of its own so the game's walk load doesn't grow. Loaded on tool pages only (tools/walker-strip.html) until the move arena (H0). Played as one-shots over the walker (src/world/figure/clips.js shoot) with mask: the bones taken from the clip (the hips, spine, head, legs and the right arm); the left arm keeps the lantern's hold, so every swing is one-handed. poses: which clips serve each pose, so the arena can pick by pose; clips: each clip's Meshy source, its pose and what it is for. Throw is still missing (an underarm toss for the sling, Cast the flame and Taproot); Point and the hand variants of Raise are made in code.
